phases.name: Source inventory
phases.acceptance: All source routes/components, RPC and secondary dashboard mapped without guessed schemas

phases.name: Native shell
phases.acceptance: Canonical Dock operations + native windows + persistence + recovery and UI keyboard tests

phases.name: Gateway adapter
phases.acceptance: Handshake, RPC, server-requests, replay/cursor/connection fail-closed tests

phases.name: Chat
phases.acceptance: Live transcript, prompt, rewind, interruptions, models, session switching verified against Hermes

phases.name: Files, previews, terminals
phases.acceptance: Real backend actions, file/PTY ownership and negative remote tests

phases.name: Git, tasks and subagents
phases.acceptance: Backend-confirmed mutation and causal state tests

phases.name: Management, plugins
phases.acceptance: Profile-scoped config/skills/MCP and explicit UI SDK compatibility gates

phases.name: Hermes-Doofus parity
phases.acceptance: Seven Control views + Vault + quota + token bridge; proof/status integrity

phases.name: OS and accessibility

phases.name: Parity signoff
